records.title: Satyr and Nymph (Townley group)

orientation.note: Source is Y-up and stands on its base, but its front faces away from the default camera; turned -60° about the vertical so the satyr (left) and the nymph twisting away from him (right) face the viewer, matching the scan author's reference view. not_available.finding: The closest match is the Brooklyn Museum's Ptolemaic limestone erotic group 58.34 ("Erotic Musicians"); its only scan (Sketchfab 28073bf7ace54b89875d49dcc6cca74e, iuegypt) is view-only with no licence. No other Ptolemaic coitus group has an open scan on Sketchfab, Zenodo's 3D archive or Objaverse.

notes: Fetched locally with the owner's Sketchfab token on 2026-10-02 after a ~1 h HTTP 429 cooldown.
